copy.speaker: Caption
copy.text: Two mornings later. Ninth round complete.

copy.speaker: Ossa
copy.text: Give Kiva my morning.

copy.speaker: Kiva
copy.text: Daro brought the packing stock up. His cart is below.

copy.speaker: Daro
copy.text: I would rather earn something on the way back.

copy.speaker: Kiva
copy.text: This set is Rusk’s. The buyer’s is still in the jig.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: I thought I was taking it to Rusk.

copy.speaker: Kiva
copy.text: You are collecting it for me. We have not agreed the rest yet.

copy.speaker: Daro
copy.text: Rusk asked for the rear yard today. His long frame is in the front aisle.

copy.speaker: Daro
copy.text: You bring the box to the landing. I take the cart leg; her board comes back with you.

copy.speaker: Daro
copy.text: The cart cannot climb these steps. From that landing, the ramp goes round to his yard.

copy.speaker: Kiva
copy.text: Aren collects. Daro may carry it from the landing to Rusk.

copy.speaker: Kiva
copy.text: If he cannot receive it, bring it back. No doorstep drop.

copy.speaker: Daro
copy.text: My usual cart share, when Rusk’s receipt comes back.

copy.speaker: Kiva
copy.text: The rest of the collection fee is yours, Aren. Agreed?

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: Agreed.

copy.speaker: Kiva
copy.text: His slip comes back. The hinges stay with him.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: One box to Rusk. The board back here.

copy.speaker: Daro
copy.text: Use the outside turn. The inside catches the board.

copy.speaker: Caption
copy.text: Later, in his own room.

copy.speaker: Sera
copy.text: How was the collection?

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: I only carried it halfway.

copy.speaker: Sera
copy.text: Did it arrive?

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: Yes.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: Will you walk to the east washhouse with us after tomorrow’s round?

copy.speaker: Sera
copy.text: Yes. With the person handing the goods over.
